correctness.rationale: The theorem classifies the least eventual period and first periodic index of T_c(n)=T_c(n-1)+c(n-1)T_c(n-2) for all integer c, moduli M>=2 by prime-power binomial-shift valuations and recurrence-based lower bounds. For v2(c)>=2, the j=1 binomial term has exact valuation r+v2(c)-1 and all higher terms are divisible by 2^(r+v2(c)); for v2(c)=1 cancellation of j=1 and j=2 gives period 2^max(2,a-1); for odd c the valuations of T_c(4k),T_c(4k+1) equal k and the next two are at least k+1, hence preperiod 4a-2. The displayed Step 5 identity for T_c(4k+4) in RESULT.md IS FALSE: at c=3,k=0 it predicts 54 while the recurrence gives 46. Direct recurrence algebra gives the replacement T_c(4k+4)=(4k+2)c T_c(4k+1)+(1+(4k+3)c)T_c(4k+2); the second coefficient is even for odd c, so the published valuation conclusion still follows independently. Checked 1975 small (c,M) exact period/preperiod pairs. Scientific statement survives this corrected derivation, but a corrected complete RESULT.md is necessary before publication.
